summary: Atlanta-based; its biggest hub, ATL, is one of the world's busiest airports.
checkin: Online and app check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Domestic: bags must be checked 45 minutes before departure, check-in without bags closes 30 minutes before, and be at the gate 15 minutes before.
baggage: A carry-on and a personal item are free. Domestic checked bags are $45 for the 1st and $55 for the 2nd (up to 50 lb / 23 kg, 62 in total).
tips: Delta SkyMiles American Express cardholders get free checked bags on domestic Delta flights.
Delta recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic flights.
You can add and pay for bags in the Fly Delta app during check-in.
